import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from Projects.Tooling.validators.validator_suite.runner import run_repo_validation


def test_repo_validation_gate_reports_clean_repo_state():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

    result = run_repo_validation(root)

    assert isinstance(result, dict)
    assert result["summary"]["failed_checks"] == 0
    assert result["summary"]["checks_run"] >= 5
    assert result["manifest_required"]["issues"] == []
    assert result["udi_shape"]["issues"] == []
    assert result["registry_schema"]["issues"] == []
    assert result["registry_schema_dependencies"]["issues"] == []
    assert result["render_smoke"]["issues"] == []
